The '''Battle of Rentean''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rentean]]. Forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] were dispatched to the planet to destroy its [[Rentean shipbuilding facility|shipbuilding facility]].<ref name="BtT:TS" />
